brief.text:
GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — clean sweep again: Higgins survives a heel scare, Tuten's handcuff picture unchanged, nothing to fix
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — earliest kickoff is Sunday 10:00 AM PT (Herbert/Hampton vs ARI)
Lineup: no changes. Higgins missed a midweek practice with a heel contusion but Zac Taylor cleared him to play vs. TB — no downgrade. LeQuint Allen (hip) is still a game-time call for Tuten's backup job; doesn't change anything, only helps Tuten's workload if Allen sits. Keaton Mitchell logged a second straight limited practice but still isn't a threat to Hampton's role. Everyone else holds — full go across the board.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — Stafford's Thursday clunker is already banked, Judkins carries the week's toughest matchup but stays in
Do now: nothing needs a change
Locks next 24h: none — Stafford, Myers, and the 49ers DEF are already final; the rest of the lineup kicks off Sunday
Lineup: no changes. Judkins missed practice this week with what Todd Monken called a nagging, precautionary issue and is not expected to miss Sunday — but pair that with JAX's 3rd-ranked run defense and he projects the week's lowest implied total (15.8); no better flex on the bench, so he stays in. If Judkins is ruled out Sunday, start Blake Corum over Tank Bigsby. Kamara was upgraded to a full practice Friday and is trending toward playing, but beat reporting still has Etienne as the clear Saints workhorse regardless of Kamara's status.

FYI: Chase Brown starts in both leagues facing a tougher-than-expected run defense in TB (graded top-10 stingiest); Michael Wilson sits on both benches with no injury concern; four Jacksonville pieces are rostered across the two leagues (Strange, Tuten, Jaguars DEF, Parker Washington); Cleveland lost DC Jim Schwartz and Myles Garrett this offseason, which tempers how much stock to put in last year's strong CLE defensive numbers for the Strange/Tuten/Washington/Judkins group.

waivers.text:
SLEEPER — TE is still the priority: you roster zero backup there, and Strange shares Week 7's JAX/LAC bye cluster with Herbert, Hampton, Tuten, and your DEF. FAAB budget is untouched at $100 (nobody in the league has spent a dollar yet) and you sit waiver position 3.
1. Darren Waller (TE, CAR) — Carolina's TE2 on the depth chart behind Tommy Tremble but the far more proven player with real path to the job. Drop Fernando Mendoza (your QB3, confirmed as Vegas' backup behind Kirk Cousins — zero standalone value). FAAB $9.
2. Samaje Perine (RB, CIN) — the direct backup to Chase Brown, who anchors your RB1 slot in BOTH leagues; this is bye-week and injury insurance you don't currently have anywhere on either roster. Drop Zachariah Branch (WR, no role in ATL). FAAB $7.
3. Justice Hill (RB, BAL) — locked in as Derrick Henry's clear #2 and the passing-down back in a full-PPR league; real standalone flex value. Drop Zavion Thomas (WR, no role in CHI). FAAB $6.
4. AJ Barner (TE, SEA) — second TE flier if you miss on Waller or want a true pair. Drop Michael Wilson (WR, buried behind Marvin Harrison Jr./Trey McBride in the ARI target mix, no path to a role). FAAB $4.
5. Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI) — cheap speculative stash in a muddled Bears backfield. Only add if you're willing to also cut Woody Marks or Stefon Diggs — your 6 bench spots are full once picks 1-4 land. FAAB $3.
No DEF/K stream needed this week — Aubrey and the Jaguars D&ST both carry plus Week 1 matchups per the Analysis tab.

YAHOO — still no access to the Yahoo free-agent pool this run (private league, no login, screenshots only). Isaiah Likely being confirmed healthy lowers urgency at TE, but Chig Okonkwo remains a thin TE2 if you want a stopgap plan. Drop a fresh screenshot of the free-agent list (Players > Available, filtered by position) into the War room Drive folder and next run can give you real availability and bid guidance.

trades.text:
SLEEPER — send Stefon Diggs to Grandmasterfabe ("Master Bate$ LaPortapotty") for Jake Ferguson (TE, DAL). Diggs is stuck behind Higgins, Flowers, and Downs on your bench with no path to starting reps; Grandmasterfabe is stacked at WR (Olave, DeVonta Smith, Jameson Williams, Jakobi Meyers, Alec Pierce) but is rolling with rookie Harold Fannin as their only real TE, with Ferguson buried as insurance. Diggs gives them a proven bye-week/injury-fill starter; you turn a fully blocked bench piece into the backup TE you currently have nowhere on the roster, which matters with Strange sharing the Week 7 JAX/LAC bye cluster. It's a mild overpay in raw value on your side, justified by how scarce TE depth is around this league right now — nobody scanned so far is sitting on two startable options. Checked your Weeks 15-17 outlook first: Diggs isn't projected to be a playoff starter behind your current WR corps, so moving him costs you nothing down the stretch.

YAHOO — no trade idea this run. I don't have visibility into other managers' rosters or trade blocks in your private Yahoo league (screenshots only cover your team and this week's opponent), so I can't responsibly name a real deal. No trade.txt found in the War room folder either.

news.headline: Tee Higgins Injury Update: What's the Latest on the Bengals Star and Will He Play in Week 1?
news.summary: Higgins missed a midweek practice with a heel contusion but was cleared by head coach Zac Taylor to play Sunday against Tampa Bay.

news.headline: Jaguars' LeQuint Allen: Questionable for Sunday's game
news.summary: Allen remains a game-time decision on a hip injury, with Ameer Abdullah standing by as the fill-in if he sits, which would grow Bhayshul Tuten's workload.

news.headline: Saints Give Alvin Kamara Unexpected Week 1 Status
news.summary: Kamara was upgraded to a full practice participant Friday and is trending toward playing Sunday, though Travis Etienne remains the Saints' clear workhorse back.

news.headline: Bengals' Samaje Perine: Backing up Brown
news.summary: Perine is confirmed as Chase Brown's direct backup in Cincinnati's backfield, with no injury concerns of his own.

news.headline: Travis Etienne Jr., Saints agree to terms
news.summary: Etienne signed a four-year, $52 million deal with New Orleans in free agency, a homecoming that made him the Saints' entrenched lead back.

news.headline: Giants TE Isaiah Likely enters Week 1 as Jaxson Dart's safety valve
news.summary: Likely signed a three-year, $40 million free-agent deal with the Giants and enters Week 1 as Jaxson Dart's top safety-valve target, with WR1 Malik Nabers questionable.

news.headline: Todd Monken: Quinshon Judkins dealing with nagging injury, out as a precaution
news.summary: Judkins missed midweek practice with what head coach Todd Monken called a precautionary, nagging injury, and is not expected to miss Sunday's opener.

news.headline: 3 reasons Jets fans should be salivating over Garrett Wilson's impending return vs. Titans
news.summary: Wilson carries no injury designation and is set to play his first game since November 2025.

news.headline: Falcons' Zachariah Branch: In clear for Sunday
news.summary: A hamstring issue limited Branch Wednesday and Thursday, but a full Friday practice clears him for his NFL debut Sunday.

news.headline: Eagles First-Round Pick Makai Lemon Returns to Practice
news.summary: Lemon's hamstring issue has resolved and he returned to full practice participation this week.

news.headline: The Four Most Anticipated Debuts for the Commanders in Week 1
news.summary: Diggs carries no injury designation and is set for his Washington debut Sunday against Philadelphia.

news.headline: Commanders' first injury report of 2026: Good news ahead of Week 1
news.summary: Okonkwo is listed with a lingering foot issue but is trending toward playing Sunday.

news.headline: Chargers vs. Cardinals Injury Report: Keaton Mitchell, Tuli Tuipulotu limited to start Week 1
news.summary: Mitchell was limited for a second straight practice day with a hamstring issue but isn't threatening Omarion Hampton's role.

news.headline: Rams vs. 49ers takeaways: Matthew Stafford pulled late in blowout loss for L.A.
news.summary: Stafford finished 15-of-25 for just 155 yards with an interception and no touchdowns as San Francisco's defense throttled the Rams 27-7 in the season opener in Melbourne.

news.headline: 49ers Open 2026 With 27-7 Win Over Rams in Melbourne; Takeaways from #SFvsLAR
news.summary: San Francisco's defense held the Rams to 7 points, intercepted Stafford, and recovered a Fred Warner-forced fumble in a dominant season-opening win.

news.headline: NFL Kickoff 2026: Seahawks beat Patriots 13-10, but lose Sam Darnold to hip injury
news.summary: Myers hit field goals of 26 and 30 yards as Seattle held on for a 13-10 win over New England after starter Sam Darnold left early with a hip injury.
